mechanism: Rasagiline (irreversible MAO-B inhibitor) combined with fluphenazine (dopamine antagonist) increases risk of neuroleptic malignant syndrome and serotonergic/dopaminergic dysregulation via monoamine accumulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring for hyperthermia, rigidity, altered mental status, and autonomic instability.
